frames.visible_job: Draw one plump upright lantern body with narrow ends and scalloped sides.
frames.instruction: Use black felt tip to draw a rounded upright lantern body. Narrow both ends and give the sides a few gentle bumps, keeping the top and bottom centers clear for fittings.

frames.visible_job: Add one top cap, one small loop, and one bottom cap at the body ends.
frames.instruction: Set a short dark cap across the top point and a matching cap beneath the bottom point. From the center of the top cap, draw a small upright loop that joins back to the cap.

frames.visible_job: Add exactly four curved ribs from upper cap toward lower cap inside the lantern.
frames.instruction: Pull two curved rib lines down the left half and two down the right, starting just below the top cap and ending just above the bottom cap. Let them bow with the paper body.

frames.visible_job: Cross the established ribs with one upper and one lower curved trim band.
frames.instruction: Draw one shallow curved band across the upper body and another across the lower body, passing over the four ribs without shifting their endpoints. Keep both bands inside the outer lantern edge.

frames.visible_job: Attach one small knot and exactly three tassel strands below the bottom cap.
frames.instruction: From the bottom cap, add one small knot. Pull three separate short strands down from it, one left, one center, and one right; stop before they touch the edge of the page.

final_step.visible_job: Fill only the established paper panels and fittings with visible marker grain.
final_step.instruction: Fill alternating rib panels coral red and orange, leave two narrow paper highlights, color the top and bottom caps deep navy, and touch the two trim bands and three tassel strands with golden yellow. Keep every black contour in place.
adds: coral red, orange, deep navy, and yellow marker fill on established shapes
